newsitem.title: USA: Fannie Mae CEO sees record earnings in 96,97.
newsitem.headline: Fannie Mae CEO sees record earnings in 96,97.

text.p: The Federal National Mortgage Association, known as Fannie Mae, is expected to post record earnings this year and next, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer James Johnson said Thursday.
"We'll have a record year in 1996 and I believe we'll have another record year in 1997," he told reporters after speaking at the National Press Club.
Asked about the drop in September housing starts reported earlier on Thursday, Johnson said the housing market generally has "shown enormous strength."
"I think we've got a very strong and healthy market with stable interest rates and a good environment for people to purchase homes," he said.
